description: A customer ID hard-coded in the test file points at a row the retention job deleted.
howSeeded: Ran the 24-month retention job, which purged CUST-1188, the account hard-coded in the test.
decidingEvidence: The retention job log showing CUST-1188 purged, against a test that was green on build #2095 and is unchanged since.
twinAxis: The same 404 on a hard-coded customer id. Here the id named a real customer that was purged; there the id names a customer that never existed.
disputeNote: Resolved 2026-09-21 in TAXONOMY.md: a literal the test uses to look something up is a reference, not a statement of what is correct, and a reference that names a record that was supposed to be there, now removed, is TEST_DATA.
